dependencies: Composer files and installed vendor unchanged; no new dependency/advisory/platform run
limits: Manual provider verification of externally signed PDFs is implemented. Electronic signing, cryptographic validation, participant authentication, employer portal access and controlled shared-copy delivery are not implemented by this batch.

Fictional unsigned PDF fixtures prove source workflow, permissions and persistence; they do not prove real signatures or identity. Independent staff must inspect the actual document and source/identity evidence.

Current approved plan, known first learning and matching frozen participant/source binding are required. Older different-plan or participant records require controlled reconciliation; full historical completeness and whole-cohort compliance remain unknown.

The cycle uses saved confirmation and snapshot integrity, not continuous byte-level storage inspection. Missing/changed actual files fail download/confirmation; target storage monitoring, private bucket, backup and recovery acceptance remain.
Only local PHP 8.4.27/Laravel 13.42.0, SQLite and loopback HTTP were tested. Actual MySQL/MariaDB/Cloud, browser/mobile/keyboard and production load acceptance were not performed.
No real data, external message, live deployment or scheduler activation. Existing marking/Careers in-portal schedules remain disabled by default; review reminder scheduling/delivery remains separate.
Complete curriculum/KSB/Foundation/S9 and gateway/source decisions, financial/funding approval, broader approved KPI policy and training-plan/HR signing remain unfinished.
